title: KL Rahul Powers to No. 2 in IPL Orange Cap Race
excerpt: Delhi Capitals opener racks up 445 runs in 10 matches, sitting just behind Klaasen as the IPL 2026 season heats up.
body:
KL Rahul is making Delhi Capitals believers out of skeptics. The Karnataka-born wicketkeeper-batter has climbed to second place on the IPL 2026 Orange Cap leaderboard, accumulating 445 runs in 10 matches at a blistering strike rate of 180.89 — a number that silences years of criticism about his T20 tempo.

**How he got here:**
Rahul briefly held the Orange Cap outright this week before SRH's Heinrich Klaasen leapfrogged him with a match-winning 69 off 43 balls against Punjab Kings. Klaasen now leads with 494 runs in 11 matches. Rahul, who reclaimed the cap mid-innings against CSK — passing SRH opener Abhishek Sharma's tally on just his 8th run of the match — remains the tournament's top-ranked Indian batter on the run-scoring charts.

**Why this campaign matters:**
Rahul joined Delhi Capitals at the IPL 2025 Mega Auction for INR 14 crore, having been released by Lucknow Super Giants after a difficult 2024 season clouded by a very public falling-out with LSG ownership. His debut year for DC was a quiet vindication — 539 runs at an average of 53.90 — and his current IPL 2026 form, including one century and three fifties, suggests he has shed the cautious instincts that long defined — and limited — his T20 reputation. His consistency is 'nearly unmatched,' having surpassed 500 runs in six different IPL seasons across his career.

**What to watch:**
With DC battling to keep their playoff hopes alive and Klaasen pulling ahead, the coming matches will reveal whether Rahul can reclaim the Orange Cap — and whether this purple patch translates into a long-awaited return to India's T20 setup.
